research.title: Multi-Agent Research Deep Dive
research.subtitle: Synthesize authoritative academic sources, cross-check claims, and audit evidence.
research.inquiryPlaceholder: Enter an academic topic or question (e.g., Photosynthesis light-dependent reactions in C4 plants)...
research.rateLimitMessage: You have reached the maximum allowed concurrent research pipelines (3 parallel tasks). Please wait for an active task to finish before launching a new one.
research.guidanceNote: Student research inquiries are independently evaluated by autonomous agents using verified academic sources, peer-reviewed DOIs, and strict robots.txt boundaries.
research.abstainMessage: The system could not find sufficient authoritative academic evidence on this topic to formulate a verifiable report.
research.unverifiedBannerText: Research reports are synthesized by AI and unverified by default. Independent verification against primary sources is required.
